title: Changes of direction.
officialText:
Cleanouts shall be installed at each change of direction of the building drain or horizontal waste or
soil lines greater than 45 degrees (0.79 rad) in the building sewer, building drain and horizontal waste or soil lines. Where more
than one change of direction occurs in a run of piping, only one cleanout shall be required for each 40 feet (12 192 mm) of
developed length of the drainage piping.
